notes: Public court records. Transcripts as published at convolutedbrian.com/dassey_confessions_links.html; federal habeas decision (E.D. Wis., Aug 12, 2016) via Northwestern Law's Center on Wrongful Convictions of Youth.

headline: Of 24 key details Brendan Dassey stated or agreed to, investigators said 8 first (1 of them in part), 5 were already public, 1 may trace to an earlier statement with no public transcript. 10 details came from him first in the record.

fact.label: Her vehicle was in Avery's garage
fact.detail: Teresa Halbach's RAV4 (Dassey calls it 'her jeep') was parked inside Steven Avery's garage that evening.
fact.source: Decision and Order, Dassey v. Dittmann (E.D. Wis. Aug 12, 2016), p. 9, citing ECF 19-25 at 24. The vehicle's discovery on the salvage yard was public by Nov 10, 2005 (CNN); its being in the garage was not reported.

facts.why: Investigators first said it (Mar 1, 2006, Manitowoc County Sheriff's Dept., p. 548); the suspect first adopted it after that (Mar 1, 2006, Manitowoc County Sheriff's Dept., p. 548).
